en.title: SDLC harness loop — Plan → gate
en.description: Step the AI-native SDLC harness: plan accept, build, evidence, and a human gate — without API keys.

steps.content: Ship the daily brief sample through the SDLC harness on my branch of aetherlink-daily-brief-lab-s1.
steps.annotation: Learner intent enters the loop — lab vehicle stays the same.

steps.content: I will stay in plan mode: draft docs/plan.md with one proof command and rollback per step, then pause for your accept.
steps.annotation: Plan beat — model proposes; does not build yet.

steps.content: {"path":"docs/plan.md","steps":[{"id":1,"do":"red schema test","proof":"npm test","rollback":"git checkout -- test/"},{"id":2,"do":"green brief.ts","proof":"npm test","rollback":"git revert HEAD"}]}
steps.annotation: Plan artifact records ordered steps with proof and rollback.

steps.content: Wrote docs/plan.md (2 steps). Status: AWAITING_HUMAN_ACCEPT
steps.annotation: Harness holds the loop at the plan gate.

steps.content: HUMAN GATE · Plan — facilitator accepts docs/plan.md (proof + rollback present). Leave plan mode.
steps.annotation: Human decides. Without accept, build does not start.

steps.content: Plan accepted. Making the schema test red, then green with src/brief.ts.
steps.annotation: Build beat — red → green after human accept.

steps.content: npm test
steps.annotation: Proof command from the plan — exit code is evidence.

steps.content:
PASS  test/schema.test.ts
exit_code=0
steps.annotation: Quoted line + exit code land in docs/evidence.md later.

steps.content: {"source":"sample/brief.sample.json"}
steps.annotation: One read-only tool on the agent — no shell, no write.

steps.content: {"headline":"Morning brief","items":3}
steps.annotation: Every sentence in the brief must trace to a tool call in run.log.

steps.content: HUMAN GATE · docs/gate.md — choose PASS, FAIL, or OPEN with citations. Refuse PASS on unread checks.
steps.annotation: Final gate — human ownership of ship decision.

steps.content: Gate filled OPEN on the weekday CI stretch. PR opened without secrets. Next intent.md follows from what merged today.
steps.annotation: Handoff closes the loop — the line becomes a loop.

nl.title: SDLC-harnesslus — Plan → gate
nl.description: Stap de AI-native SDLC-harness: plan-akkoord, build, bewijs en een menselijke gate — zonder API-sleutels.

steps.content: Breng de daily-brief-sample door de SDLC-harness op mijn branch van aetherlink-daily-brief-lab-s1.
steps.annotation: De intent van de lerende komt in de lus — het lab-voertuig blijft hetzelfde.

steps.content: Ik blijf in plan mode: ik schrijf docs/plan.md met één bewijscommando en rollback per stap, en pauzeer voor jouw akkoord.
steps.annotation: Plan-beat — het model stelt voor; bouwt nog niet.

steps.content: {"path":"docs/plan.md","steps":[{"id":1,"do":"rode schematest","proof":"npm test","rollback":"git checkout -- test/"},{"id":2,"do":"groene brief.ts","proof":"npm test","rollback":"git revert HEAD"}]}
steps.annotation: Het planartefact legt geordende stappen vast met bewijs en rollback.

steps.content: docs/plan.md geschreven (2 stappen). Status: AWAITING_HUMAN_ACCEPT
steps.annotation: De harness houdt de lus bij de plan-gate.

steps.content: MENSELIJKE GATE · Plan — facilitator accepteert docs/plan.md (bewijs + rollback aanwezig). Verlaat plan mode.
steps.annotation: De mens beslist. Zonder akkoord start de build niet.

steps.content: Plan geaccepteerd. Eerst de schematest rood, daarna groen met src/brief.ts.
steps.annotation: Build-beat — rood → groen na menselijk akkoord.

steps.content: npm test
steps.annotation: Bewijscommando uit het plan — exitcode is bewijs.

steps.content:
PASS  test/schema.test.ts
exit_code=0
steps.annotation: Geciteerde regel + exitcode komen later in docs/evidence.md.

steps.content: {"source":"sample/brief.sample.json"}
steps.annotation: Eén read-only tool op de agent — geen shell, geen write.

steps.content: {"headline":"Ochtendbrief","items":3}
steps.annotation: Elke zin in de brief moet herleidbaar zijn naar een tool-call in run.log.

steps.content: MENSELIJKE GATE · docs/gate.md — kies PASS, FAIL of OPEN met citaten. Weiger PASS op ongelezen checks.
steps.annotation: Eindgate — menselijke eigendom van de ship-beslissing.

steps.content: Gate op OPEN voor de weekday-CI-stretch. PR open zonder secrets. Volgende intent.md volgt uit wat vandaag is gemerged.
steps.annotation: Handoff sluit de lus — de lijn wordt een lus.
